items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I used to see Dutch Williams, who was the road manager

ctx.x: Because after all the time that I spent in that band, I used to see Dutch Williams, who was the road manager -- getting a little tired now, but I'm going to finish this. Come by every night after the job in the bus, and would give Lunceford some money.

Well, later on -- Mose Allen discovered it, bass player -- that Lunceford was a hired man, just like we were in the band. Now, Lunceford's dead, Oxley's dead, but I can say it, and I'm saying it. He was hired just like we were. And yet, Lunceford was the owner and the leader of the band. Only he was getting very paid every night and we got paid every week.
